Custom package error function

Source: R/Integrity.R
fram_abort.Rd

Custom wrapper for cli::cli_abort(), which passes the class "framrsquared_error" to the error message. This means that testthat::expect_error() and similar message checking can specifically check for framrsquared error messages.

Usage

fram_abort(
  message,
  internal_error = FALSE,
  class = NULL,
  call = rlang::caller_env(),
  .envir = parent.frame(),
  ...
)

Arguments

message

Error message, handled the same as cli::cli_abort message argument

internal_error

Is this errror likely reflecting a problem with FRAM (TRUE) or a user input error (FALSE)? If TRUE, message will include suggestion to file an issue on github. Logical, defaults to FALSE.

class

Additional error classes to add. Character vector. Defaults to NULL

call

calling function, used to label the function that errored.

.envir

execution environment, used to populate info in error messages.

...

arguments passed to cli::cli_abort
